quiz.question: A broken white centre line on the road means:
options: You may cross to overtake if it is safe to do so

quiz.question: When a level crossing has flashing lights you must:
options: Slow down and proceed if no train is visible
Stop and wait until the lights stop and barriers open
Sound your horn and cross quickly

quiz.question: In the model town, a marked bus stop zone means:
options: Temporary parking is allowed for drop-off
No private vehicles may park or stop in that zone

quiz.question: At an unmarked intersection where two vehicles arrive simultaneously, right of way goes to:
Parking within 5 metres of a junction is:
options: Allowed if hazard lights are on
Prohibited as it obstructs visibility and traffic flow
